observations.behavior: Adds transactional atomicity and shared helper for archiving notifications, replacing inline bulk_create and unread-count invalidation.
observations.posthog_connection: Archiving a notification removes it from the unread count; this hunk ensures the read state and archive state are updated atomically, preventing a notification from remaining unread after archiving.
